feedback_text: Workflow retries are difficult to diagnose after a regional timeout.
Keyboard navigation in the policy editor skips conditional fields.
A native connector for the service desk would remove manual exports.
Audit exports should include the human approver and policy version.
Reviewers need threaded comments on proposed workflow changes.
Customers cannot predict which usage tier fits seasonal volume.
Customers need clearer failure reasons when a Collections job stops.
Administrators want bulk policy editing with a safe preview.
Webhook delivery needs replay controls and better error details.
Leadership needs a weekly reliability view by region.
Approval reminders should respect local working hours.
Procurement wants a clearer enterprise feature comparison.
The retry queue should preserve the original execution context.
The settings hierarchy is difficult for new account administrators.
Customers want documented examples for the approvals API.
Usage dashboards should exclude suspended tenants by default.
Product and Security need one shared release checkpoint view. This blocks our October rollout.
Account teams need advance notice when customers near usage limits.
